headline: Musk mocks Altman over home PC RAM
dek: OpenAI's CEO called everyone owning RAM at home terrible, per TechRadar.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Altman's remark
body: Sam Altman told the Cheeky Pint channel it is terrible that people own RAM at home and use it 5% of the time (TechRadar).
He says pooling memory in data centers would be more efficient, per Computer Hoy.

s4.title: Why RAM is scarce
body: Chipmakers prioritize memory for AI data centers, which pay more, per Computer Hoy.

caption.hook: Elon Musk mocked Sam Altman after he called people owning RAM at home terrible.
body: Per TechRadar and Computer Hoy, Altman said it is terrible that everyone holds part of the world's DRAM in their own computer and uses it 5% of the time. Musk answered on X with a meme and the line "the people deserve to have their RAM too."
The spat comes amid a memory shortage: chipmakers prioritize AI data centers and, per TechRadar, Samsung and SK Hynix hold under ten days of stock. Computer Hoy says the shortage may last into 2027.
caption.cta: Should AI data centers get priority over home PCs for memory?
